design_philosophy.description: A fusion of Swiss precision and luxury hospitality. It feels like entering a First Class lounge—bright, airy, exclusive, and hyper-functional. We reject the 'dark mode gamer' aesthetic for a 'platinum card' feel.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix 'Swiss Poster' typography with 'Luxury Hotel' textures.
Emotion First: Every interaction must feel expensive (weighty animations, smooth scrolls).
Content is King: Events are the heroes. Use massive imagery and negative space.
Zoom In: Close-ups of emotions (fans screaming, drivers focusing) > generic wide shots.
Negative Space: 3x more whitespace than competitors. Luxury is space.
Glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' (high blur, high saturation) not 'Muddy Plastic'.

rules: Headings (H1-H3): Space Grotesk. Weight: 700/800. Tracking: -0.03em. Leading: 1.1.
Body: Outfit. Weight: 400/500. Leading: 1.6. Tracking: normal.
Overlines/Labels: Space Grotesk or Unbounded. Uppercase. Tracking: 0.1em. Text-xs.

gradients.hero_mesh: radial-gradient(at 0% 0%, hsla(253,16%,7%,1) 0, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(at 50% 0%, hsla(225,39%,30%,1) 0, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(at 100% 0%, hsla(339,49%,30%,1) 0, transparent 50%)

cards.classes: bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/40 shadow-xl hover:shadow-2xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-500

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-full px-8 py-4 text-lg font-semibold shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:scale-105 transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-primary border border-primary/10 rounded-full px-8 py-4 text-lg font-semibold hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all duration-300
buttons.accent: bg-accent text-accent-foreground rounded-full px-8 py-4 text-lg font-bold shadow-gold hover:shadow-gold-lg hover:scale-105 transition-all duration-300

inputs.style: bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-md border-border focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 transition-all duration-300 rounded-xl h-14 px-6 text-lg

interactions.entrance: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}

universal_guidelines.colors: No gradients for text. High contrast always.
universal_guidelines.spacing: Use p-8 or p-12 for containers. Don't crowd content.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure text contrast > 4.5:1. Use ARIA labels.
universal_guidelines.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE TAILWIND CONFIG: Replace the dark mode colors in `tailwind.config.js` with the palette provided above. Set `darkMode: 'class'` but default to light.
2. UPDATE CSS VARIABLES: In `index.css`, update the `:root` variables to match the Light Mode palette. Remove the dark background logic.
3. COMPONENT REFRESH: Rewrite `App.js` and major components to use the new 'Glassmorphism Crystal' styles. Remove all `bg-zinc-900` classes and replace with `bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-xl`.
4. TYPOGRAPHY: Ensure `Space Grotesk` is used for all headings with `tracking-tight`.
5. MOTION: Add `framer-motion` to all page transitions and card interactions.
6. TRUST: Add a dedicated 'Trust & Guarantee' section with emerald green shields/icons in the hero or just below it.
7. HEADER: Make the header sticky, glassmorphism, with a big 'Sign In' or 'My Tickets' pill button.
8. MOBILE: Ensure the 'Buy' button is sticky at the bottom on mobile screens.
